mapper.select: SELECT sm.*, kp.name as kp_name, kp.branch as branch, u.user_name as student_name FROM student_mastery sm LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON sm.kp_id = kp.id LEFT JOIN ape_user u ON sm.student_id = u.id WHERE sm.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sm.mastery_score DESC
SELECT sm.*, kp.name as kp_name, kp.branch as branch FROM student_mastery sm LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON sm.kp_id = kp.id WHERE sm.student_id = #{studentId} AND sm.kp_id = #{kpId}

SELECT kp.branch as branch, AVG(sm.mastery_score) as avgMastery FROM student_mastery sm LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON sm.kp_id = kp.id WHERE sm.student_id = #{studentId} AND kp.branch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY kp.branch
mapper.update: UPDATE student_mastery SET practice_count = practice_count + 1, correct_count = correct_count + CASE WHEN #{correct} = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, last_practice_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND kp_id = #{kpId}
